column4: cleat#2181 (e): this test is specific to sweepStaleWorkflowRefsMSSQL, MSSQL-only, and used to `continue` past every non-MSSQL backend with no t.Run and no skip event -- a vacuous pass in test-go/plugins, which provides only PostgreSQL (ci.yml's plugins matrix entry). It now skips explicitly when CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL is not set, guarded on "was MSSQL requested" (NewPluginTestBackends/MSSQLTestDB Fatal, not skip, if it is requested and unreachable) rather than on reachability. Measured: 1 skip, top-level (no subtest ever starts), confirmed by running `go test ./plugins/blobstore/... -run TestSweepStaleWorkflowRefsMSSQL_DeterministicInterleave -v` with CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL unset.
